profiles.description: CPU-requested runtime profile using the local llama-server --device none flag via the wrapper -CpuOnly option; strict CPU-only execution is not proven by device-level telemetry.
limitations: The wrapper emits --device none and rejects GPU placement flags for this profile.
GPU telemetry is collected at the device level with nvidia-smi, so unrelated desktop or driver activity can still appear in samples.
A profile run must not be described as truly strict CPU-only unless per-process or server-level evidence proves llama-server did not use GPU resources.

profiles.description: GPU runtime profile using explicit full layer offload flags observed in local llama-server help and previous smoke runs.
limitations: Full offload is requested with --n-gpu-layers 999; the exact placement remains llama-server dependent.
Flash attention is not enabled in this profile because the previous successful GPU smoke did not require it.
This profile is for bounded research smoke only, not production sizing.
